propose.title: Propose a topic
propose.lead: You don't have to be an expert.
propose.leadBody: Anything you've tried that worked — or didn't — is worth hearing. Write your idea the way you'd tell it, and an admin will follow up to arrange the rest.
propose.noScheduleNote: You don't pick a date or a place — an admin sets those once your topic is approved.

form.titleHint: For example: how we halved the time it takes to prepare our reports
form.abstractHint: Explain the idea and who it helps
form.audienceHint: Who is this for? For example: anyone who prepares the monthly reports
form.durationHint: A first estimate only — an admin sets the final duration when scheduling
form.notesHint: Anything you'd like the admin to know before reviewing
form.coPresentersHint: Choose colleagues presenting with you. Each is notified and each may decline.
form.coPresentersLimit: {count, plural, =0 {no co-presenters can be added} one {you may name one colleague} other {you may name {value} colleagues}}
form.coPresentersNone: There are no other members in your organisation yet.
form.errorSummaryCount: {count, plural, =0 {We couldn't send the proposal} one {We couldn't send the proposal — one field needs fixing} other {We couldn't send the proposal — {value} fields need fixing}}
form.errorSummaryDescription: {count, plural, =0 {What you typed is still here.} one {Select it to go straight to it. What you typed is still here.} other {Select any of them to go straight to it. What you typed is still here.}}
form.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {All required fields are filled in} one {Remaining: one required field} other {Remaining: {value} required fields}}
form.materialsNote: You can attach draft materials once the proposal is saved.
form.presentersElsewhere: Presenters are managed on the proposal's own page.

errors.titleRequired: Please enter a title for your proposed topic
errors.titleTooShort: That title is too short — add a word or two so the idea is clear
errors.titleTooLong: That title is longer than it needs to be — shorten it a little
errors.abstractRequired: Please write a short description of your topic
errors.abstractTooLong: That description is longer than it needs to be — shorten it a little
errors.categoryRequired: Choose a category for your topic
errors.audienceTooLong: That description is longer than it needs to be — shorten it a little
errors.durationInvalid: Enter a sensible duration — from a quarter of an hour to eight hours
errors.notesTooLong: Those notes are longer than they need to be — shorten them a little
errors.failed: We couldn't save your proposal — try again. Your text is still in the form.
errors.coPresentersTooMany: That is more co-presenters than your organisation allows
errors.coPresentersUnknown: One of the people you chose is no longer a member of your organisation
errors.notEditable: This proposal can no longer be edited — an admin may have just reviewed it. What you typed is still in the form.

created.submittedTitle: We have your proposal — thank you
created.submittedBody: Your proposal <t>{title}</t> is now with an admin for review. We'll let you know the outcome, and if a change is needed you'll get a clear reason.
created.draftTitle: Your proposal is saved as a draft
created.draftBody: The draft <t>{title}</t> is saved and has not reached an admin yet. Send it whenever it's ready.

propose.duration: {count, plural, =0 {no set duration} one {one minute} other {{value} minutes}}

mine.title: My proposals
mine.empty: You haven't proposed a topic yet.
mine.count: {count, plural, =0 {no proposals} one {one proposal} other {{value} proposals}}

proposal.notFound: There is no proposal at this link, or it is not yours to read.
proposal.approvedNote: An admin will set the date and place and publish the session.
proposal.inviteTitle: You were invited to present this topic
proposal.inviteBody: If you accept, your name appears among the presenters and you share the presenter points and certificate.
proposal.nextPending: You'll be notified when an admin decides.
proposal.nextDraft: This is your draft — it hasn't reached an admin yet.
proposal.removeConfirmBody: Their name will no longer appear among this proposal's presenters.

updated.submittedTitle: Your proposal is sent for review
updated.submittedBody: Your proposal <t>{title}</t> is with an admin now, and you'll be notified of the decision.
